units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:3">Yoma V, 3</cite>, sq. <he>לא היה … אלא כמַצְלִיף</he> (in sprinkling upward and downward) he did not aim at a certain point above or below, but made the movement of swinging a whip; <cite ref="Yoma 15a">ib. 15ᵃ</cite>; a. e., v. <cite ref="M01707"><he>מַנְגְּדָנָא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="I00091"><he>טִבְרֵר</he></cite>.
